deviations.what: A new public class, ContributionListSerializer, holds a record's credits, beside the three serializers the plan names.
deviations.why: A credit whose contributor was deleted has to be absent on every path, including the body answering a create or an update, and credits that arrive without the name annotation need their names read for the whole list with one query.

deviations.what: Two moved tests lost assertions on keys the list shape does not carry (type, profile and links on a person; type and parent on an organization), and two other pre-existing tests were changed to read the new credit keys.
deviations.why: The brief serves the list shape for a single record in this story and replaces the credit shape, so the old keys are not in any response.

deviations.what: PersonViewSet and OrganizationViewSet order by name then primary key.
deviations.why: The people queryset has no default ordering, and name alone has ties, so pages can repeat or skip an entry.

concerns: Pre-existing tests changed that the brief does not name as moved or replaced, so tamper-check will flag them and Forge should triage: tests/test_api/test_viewsets.py TestCompleteRecord.test_a_credited_contributor_is_named_with_roles_and_affiliation (reads credit['uuid'] and credit['affiliation'][0]['uuid'] instead of the old nested references) and TestReferencesFollowTheLists.test_a_credit_to_a_listed_contributor_is_a_reference (reads the credit's uuid). Neither can keep its old assertion once a credit has the new shape. Both are listed in progress.md under T004.

TestContributor.test_a_person_is_returned_with_what_their_profile_page_shows and test_an_organisation_is_returned_with_what_its_profile_page_shows no longer assert type, profile, links and the parent: a single record serves the list shape in this story, so the person and organization record stories need to bring those assertions back on their own serializers.

tests/test_api/test_viewsets.py::TestCreditQueries passed before the credit rewrite, as a guard the old serializer already satisfied. It was probed after T005 by removing the identifier prefetches and the name annotation in turn, and failed both times.
